_comment: The homepage 'What's new in Ze' band, rendered by `./le site build` directly above the proof strip. The article and weekly-update slots are generated from the newest blog/posts/*.md and changes/posts/*.md, so only the freeform note below is edited by hand. Keep title and body short: the band sits above the fold and the KPI cards under it must stay visible on a laptop screen. `category` uses the shared subject vocabulary; use `meta` for mixed or project-wide news. Drop the whole `note` object to render the band with two slots.
